tools.name: intent_publish_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user asks AutoIsto to keep watching Slovak car listings for them over time (e.g. "let me know until March about an estate car under 15 000 €, not diesel"). This does NOT start watching by itself and takes no e-mail address or other personal data: it returns a consentUrl on www.auto

tools.name: intent_get_intent
tools.description: Use this to check whether an intent created with intent_publish_intent is already confirmed by the user and active, waiting, expired or withdrawn. Requires the intentCode; returns the statement and dates only — never the user's e-mail, the hidden limit or any other personal data.

tools.name: intent_list_matches
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what AutoIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same cars AutoIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer matches.

tools.name: intent_withdraw_intent
tools.description: Use this when the user wants AutoIsto to stop watching for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. Takes effect immediately; nothing more is e-mailed for it. Requires the intentCode.

tools.name: intent_search_offers
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in Slovakia now. Pass what they are looking for as one short phrase (Slovak or Czech works best), e.g. "škoda octavia kombi do 12000 eur". Returns up to 20 cars from AutoIsto's offer in AutoIsto's own order, each with a link to the car on www.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "zamery" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: intent_list_matches · Private data: intent_search_offers · Public sink: intent_publish_intent, intent_list_matches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: intent_list_matches · Private data: intent_search_offers · Public sink: intent_publish_intent, intent_list_matches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
